key: Hello. Welcome to Silph Co.'s Reborn branch headquarters.
en: Hello. Welcome to Silph Co.'s Reborn branch headquarters.
ja: こんにちは。シルフカンパニー、リボーン支社へようこそ。

key: Due to security issues in the Kanto Region, the business levels of our building are not available to the public.
en: Due to security issues in the Kanto Region, the business levels of our building are not available to the public.
ja: カントー地方でのセキュリティ上の問題により、このビルの業務フロアは一般公開しておりません。

key: However, we encourage you to take a brochure, and please check out our vast array of products located in our neighboring Department Store.
en: However, we encourage you to take a brochure, and please check out our vast array of products located in our neighboring Department Store.
ja: ですが、ぜひパンフレットをお持ちください。隣接するデパートで、豊富な商品の数々もご覧いただけます。

key: As always, the upper levels are unavailable to the public.
en: As always, the upper levels are unavailable to the public.
ja: いつも通り、上層階は一般の方はご利用いただけません。

key: However, please look forward to a classic product line soon making a reappearance in Reborn: The world famous Silph Scope will soon be available!
en: However, please look forward to a classic product line soon making a reappearance in Reborn: The world famous Silph Scope will soon be available!
ja: ですが、リボーンで間もなく復活する定番商品にご期待ください。世界的に有名なシルフスコープが、まもなく発売されます!

key: Further, we are hiring for many positions. If you are interested in joining one of the strongest international corporations, please take an application.
en: Further, we are hiring for many positions. If you are interested in joining one of the strongest international corporations, please take an application.
ja: また、現在多くの職種で採用を行っております。世界有数の国際企業への入社にご興味があれば、応募用紙をお持ちください。

key: Would you like one?
en: Would you like one?
ja: 一枚お持ちになりますか?

key: ATTENDANT: Oh, hello!
en: ATTENDANT: Oh, hello!
ja: 係員: あ、こんにちは!

key: I'm Silph Co.'s distribution management attendant.
en: I'm Silph Co.'s distribution management attendant.
ja: 私はシルフカンパニーの流通管理担当です。

key: If you have problems with our product delivery, or you have an idea for a new product or service for us to bring to Reborn City, I'd love to hear about it.
en: If you have problems with our product delivery, or you have an idea for a new product or service for us to bring to Reborn City, I'd love to hear about it.
ja: 商品の配送に問題があったり、リボーンシティに導入してほしい新商品やサービスのアイデアがあれば、ぜひ聞かせてください。

key: Just,
en: Just,
ja: ただ、

key: Unless it's about Kecleon...
en: Unless it's about Kecleon...
ja: カクレオンのことでなければ、ですが……

key: Sorry-- that might seem strange. It's just...
en: Sorry-- that might seem strange. It's just...
ja: すみません――変に聞こえたかもしれませんね。実は……

key: We keep getting complaints from residents of the Beryl Ward that Kecleon have been running out from Rhodochrine Jungle and getting in their way.
en: We keep getting complaints from residents of the Beryl Ward that Kecleon have been running out from Rhodochrine Jungle and getting in their way.
ja: ベリルワードの住民の方々から、ロドクラインジャングルからカクレオンが飛び出してきて邪魔だという苦情が絶えないんです。

key: Something seems to be chasing them out of the jungle.
en: Something seems to be chasing them out of the jungle.
ja: 何かがジャングルから彼らを追い立てているようで。

key: Whatever that is... is probably not something we can deal with.
en: Whatever that is... is probably not something we can deal with.
ja: それが何であれ……たぶん私たちの手に負えるものじゃないでしょうね。

key: Nevertheless, these startled Kecleon panic, so they hide themselves around Beryl, and then it's a real bother.
en: Nevertheless, these startled Kecleon panic, so they hide themselves around Beryl, and then it's a real bother.
ja: それでも、驚いたカクレオンたちはパニックになって、ベリル中に隠れてしまうので、本当に厄介なんです。

key: Our competitors should have the Devon Scope, which allows invisible Pokémon to be seen...
en: Our competitors should have the Devon Scope, which allows invisible Pokémon to be seen...
ja: 本来なら競合他社が、姿の見えないポケモンを見られるデボンスコープを持っているはずなんですが……

key: But it seems Devon has suddenly completely shut down.
en: But it seems Devon has suddenly completely shut down.
ja: でも、デボン社は突然完全に業務を停止してしまったようで。

key: But call it bad business sense or something else-- they don't seem to be selling any!
en: But call it bad business sense or something else-- they don't seem to be selling any!
ja: 商売下手なのか何なのか――全然売ってくれないんです!

key: Their customer service just keeps telling people to look elsewhere.
en: Their customer service just keeps telling people to look elsewhere.
ja: 問い合わせても、他を当たれの一点張りで。

key: Remembering the Silph Scope, people come here.
en: Remembering the Silph Scope, people come here.
ja: シルフスコープのことを思い出して、みんなここに来るんですよ。

key: You're not the same, are you?
en: You're not the same, are you?
ja: あなたも、そうなんじゃないですか?
……ああ。

key: So you are.
en: So you are.
ja: やっぱりそうですか。

key: To tell the truth, I don't know how to handle this situation.
en: To tell the truth, I don't know how to handle this situation.
ja: 正直、この状況、どう対処すればいいのかわからないんです。

key: Is there any chance I could ask for your help on this?
en: Is there any chance I could ask for your help on this?
ja: 手伝っていただくこと、お願いできませんか?

key: ATTENDENT: Oh, thank goodness.
en: ATTENDENT: Oh, thank goodness.
ja: 係員: ああ、よかった。

key: I don't know how to handle this situation. Hey-- maybe you could help me?
en: I don't know how to handle this situation. Hey-- maybe you could help me?
ja: この状況、どう対処すればいいのかわからなくて。もしかして、手伝ってもらえますか?

key: What I'm going to say, isn't... technically legal.
en: What I'm going to say, isn't... technically legal.
ja: これから言うこと、厳密には……合法ではないんですが。

key: But given the situation with Devon, maybe we can make an exception here.
en: But given the situation with Devon, maybe we can make an exception here.
ja: でも、デボン社のこの状況を考えると、今回は例外にしてもいいかもしれません。

key: I'd like you to scope out that building and see if you can find some kind of old model of their Devon Scope, and bring it back to me.
en: I'd like you to scope out that building and see if you can find some kind of old model of their Devon Scope, and bring it back to me.
ja: あの建物を調べて、デボンスコープの古いモデルのようなものを見つけて、持ち帰ってきてほしいんです。

key: We should be able to create a hybrid scope with it. That way both the company and the people will benefit!
en: We should be able to create a hybrid scope with it.  That way both the company and the people will benefit!
ja: それがあれば、ハイブリッドスコープが作れるはずです。そうすれば会社も住民も助かります!

key: Of course, if you get caught, please don't mention you're affiliated with us!
en: Of course, if you get caught, please don't mention you're affiliated with us!
ja: もちろん、もし見つかっても、私たちと関係があるとは言わないでくださいね!

key: ATTENDANT: That's-- you actually got it?!
en: ATTENDANT: That's-- you actually got it?!
ja: 係員: それは……本当に手に入れたんですか?!

key: Amazing...
en: Amazing...
ja: すごい……

key: Ah, may I see that?
en: Ah, may I see that?
ja: あ、見せてもらえますか?

key: \PN handed over the Devon Scope Model.
en: \PN handed over the Devon Scope Model.
ja: \PNはデボンスコープしさくひんを渡した。

key: ATTENDANT: ...Oh.
en: ATTENDANT: ...Oh.
ja: 係員: ……あら。

key: This is just a display model.
en: This is just a display model.
ja: これ、ただの展示用モデルですね。

key: It's really all they had?
en: It's really all they had?
ja: 本当にこれしかなかったんですか?

key: All right, I can work with this.
en: All right, I can work with this.
ja: まあいいでしょう、これなら何とかなります。

key: I didn't get to this position just by shooting the breeze with consumers all day!
en: I didn't get to this position just by shooting the breeze with consumers all day!
ja: 一日中お客さんと世間話をしてるだけで、この立場に就いたわけじゃありませんから!

key: ATTENDANT: Voila!
en: ATTENDANT: Voila!
ja: 係員: できました!

key: By analyzing the structure, reverse engineering the component functions, and hybridizing them with Silph's own scope technologies...
en: By analyzing the structure, reverse engineering the component functions, and hybridizing them with Silph's own scope technologies...
ja: 構造を分析して、部品の機能をリバースエンジニアリングし、シルフ独自のスコープ技術と融合させることで……

key: I've created the Silvon Scope!
en: I've created the Silvon Scope!
ja: シルヴォンスコープを作り上げました!

key: ATTENDANT: You can go ahead and keep that one as thanks for your work.
en: ATTENDANT: You can go ahead and keep that one as thanks for your work.
ja: 係員: それはお仕事のお礼として、そのままお持ちください。

key: It's the prototype, but I've already recorded everything I need to send off to R and D.
en: It's the prototype, but I've already recorded everything I need to send off to R and D.
ja: 試作品ですが、研究開発部に送るために必要なデータはもう記録してあります。

key: Now I'm sure to get that promotion!
en: Now I'm sure to get that promotion!
ja: これで昇進間違いなしですね!

key: Ah, I mean--
en: Ah, I mean--
ja: あ、いえ――

key: Now we're sure to settle that commotion!
en: Now we're sure to settle that commotion!
ja: これで騒動もきっと収まりますね!

key: Good luck now, Trainer, and thanks for everything!
en: Good luck now, Trainer, and thanks for everything!
ja: それじゃあ頑張ってくださいね、トレーナーさん。本当にありがとうございました!

key: ATTENDANT: I'd like you to scope out that building and see if you can find some kind of old model of their Devon Scope, and bring it back to me.
en: ATTENDANT: I'd like you to scope out that building and see if you can find some kind of old model of their Devon Scope, and bring it back to me.
ja: 係員: あの建物を調べて、デボンスコープの古いモデルのようなものを見つけて、持ち帰ってきてほしいんです。

key: ATTENDANT: Good luck now, Trainer, and thanks for everything!
en: ATTENDANT: Good luck now, Trainer, and thanks for everything!
ja: 係員: それじゃあ頑張ってくださいね、トレーナーさん。本当にありがとうございました!

key: REPRESENTATIVE: I'll contact you as soon as we have something for you then.
en: REPRESENTATIVE: I'll contact you as soon as we have something for you then.
ja: 担当者: 何かご用意でき次第、ご連絡しますね。

key: CIVILIAN: Thank you very much! I'll look forward to it.
en: CIVILIAN: Thank you very much! I'll look forward to it.
ja: 市民: どうもありがとうございます! 楽しみにしていますね。

key: Have a good day.
en: Have a good day.
ja: 良い一日を。

key: CIVILIAN: Oh, pardon.
en: CIVILIAN: Oh, pardon.
ja: 市民: あ、失礼しました。

key: ATTENDANT: Geez, that's the sixth one this week...
en: ATTENDANT: Geez, that's the sixth one this week...
ja: 係員: はぁ、今週これで六人目……

key: Just what's going on?
en: Just what's going on?
ja: 一体何が起きてるんでしょう?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
